snippet.title: Pettson's Inventions Now on Android & iOS
snippet.description:
Android Release date: Thursday October 11:th!

Help Pettson build his tricky inventions! Help him drag the correct pieces to the right place in the invention. If you get it right you will receive cogwheels as a prize. These are then used later on in the final invention - one that will help Findus fly!
